description: This file defines a Orleans grain class 'FilteredImplicitSubscriptionGrain' which utilizes implicit stream subscriptions, handles stream events, and manages counters per stream namespace.

classes.name: FilteredImplicitSubscriptionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that subscribes to streams with implicit subscription, logs events, and maintains counters per stream namespace.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes stream subscriptions and counters when the grain activates.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Returns the current count of received events for a specified stream namespace.
